description: Calculate Nigeria PAYE income tax and net (take-home) salary under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025, effective for the 2026 tax year. Returns monthly take-home, monthly PAYE, the effective rate, and the full band-by-band working, with the statutory source and verification date. Handles pension (8%), NHF (2.5%, voluntary), rent relief (20% of rent, capped at ₦500,000), and the minimum-wage exemption. Figures are informational — verify with the tax authority. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/ng/paye

grossIncome.description: Gross salary in naira (before tax and deductions).

includeNhf.description: Deduct the 2.5% National Housing Fund contribution — voluntary for private-sector employees since 2023. Default false.

includePension.description: Deduct the 8% employee pension contribution (PRA 2014). Default true.

otherDeductionsAnnual.description: Other eligible annual deductions actually paid (NHIS, life-insurance premium), in naira.

period.description: Whether grossIncome is monthly or annual. Default monthly.

rentPaidAnnual.description: Annual rent actually paid, in naira. Unlocks rent relief (20% of rent, capped at ₦500,000). Relief is claim-based: omit if no rent is declared.

name: ng_paye_calculate
title: Nigeria PAYE calculator (2026)
